positions.name: CalibrationSettledStatus
positions.frame: how is the spectrograph calibration's settled status established across the witness's verified claim and the document's keyed decision record?
positions.why: Both expressions carry the same calibration content — 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates — but perform its settling differently: src-1 is Quill's unhedged claim of collective verification in native technical voice, while src-2 is the document author's ratification of the same facts as a keyed decision. The shared directional read is how completion gets established, with an internal tension between claim (src-1) and decision (src-2) that the frame holds without resolving.
